kiosk.subtitle: Gate attendance · Sheet Shapers
kiosk.help: Need help? Ask the plant office.

pairing.title: Pair this device
pairing.instruction: Type the 6-digit code from the admin screen: Attendance devices › Add device.
pairing.filledFromLink: Code filled in from the link.
pairing.wrongCode: This code is not right. Type it again.
pairing.locationText: It proves this device is at the plant gate. When the browser asks, press Allow.
pairing.accuracyNow: accuracy now · needs ± {{metres}} m or better · waits up to 20 s

paired.title: Paired
paired.later: Attendance starts in a later update. Keep this screen open; the admin can see it is online.

code-expired.title: Code expired
code-expired.message: This code has expired. Ask the admin for a new code.
steps: On the admin screen, press “Make a new code”.
Type the new code here within 10 minutes.

locked.title: Too many tries
locked.message: Too many tries. Ask the admin for a new code.
steps: The old code does not work any more.
Ask the admin to make a new code, then type it here.

location-off.title: Location is off
location-off.message: Turn on location on this device and allow it for this site, then try again.
steps: Turn on Location in the phone or Windows settings.
When the browser asks, press “Allow”.

gps-weak.title: Location not accurate enough
gps-weak.message: The device cannot find its place well enough. Turn on Wi‑Fi or move near a window, then try again.
steps: Turn on Wi‑Fi. It does not need to connect to a network.
Move the device near a window or the open gate.
Press “Try again”.

outside.title: Not at the plant
outside.message: This device is not at the plant.
steps: Take this device to the plant gate.
Press “Try again” there.
Already at the gate? Ask the admin to check the plant boundary.

unsupported.title: Browser not supported
unsupported.message: Open this page in the latest Chrome or Edge.
steps: Open Chrome or Edge on this device (update it if it asks).
Open the attendance page again.
Use the site address that starts with https.

revoked.title: Switched off
revoked.message: This device has been switched off by the admin.
steps: To use it again, the admin adds it as a new attendance device.
Then type the new code on this device.

network.title: No connection
network.message: The internet is not reachable. Check the connection and try again.
steps: Check that the device is online.
Press “Try again”.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.message: Pairing did not work. Try again, or ask the admin for help.
steps: Press “Try again”.
If it keeps failing, tell the admin the code below.

CAMERA_BLOCKED.message: Allow the camera for this site.

offline.title: Offline attendance devices
offline.description: How long a gate device may work without internet, and when it counts as offline.

gps_accuracy_limit_m.label: GPS accuracy limit
gps_accuracy_limit_m.help: A device must report its location at least this precisely to pair and to punch. Plants in MIDC Waluj are close together: a larger value may let a device at a neighbouring plant punch here.

geofence_default_buffer_m.label: Default geofence margin
geofence_default_buffer_m.help: Extra metres around a drawn geofence, so GPS jitter at the edge does not refuse a device. A punch inside this margin is accepted but flagged for review.

pairing_code_minutes.label: Pairing code life
pairing_code_minutes.help: How long an attendance device pairing code works.

session_idle_minutes.label: Log out after being idle
session_idle_minutes.help: A user who does nothing for this long must log in again.

session_max_hours.label: Longest login
session_max_hours.help: After this many hours everyone must log in again.

login_max_failures.label: Wrong passwords before lock
login_max_failures.help: After this many wrong passwords the account is locked for a while.

login_lock_minutes.label: Lock time
login_lock_minutes.help: How long a locked account stays locked.

punch_cooldown_minutes.label: Punch cool-down
punch_cooldown_minutes.help: A second punch by the same person within this time is refused.

snapshot_retention_days.label: Snapshot retention
snapshot_retention_days.help: QR-punch photos are deleted after this many days.

face_match_threshold.label: Face match threshold
face_match_threshold.help: How similar a face must be to count as a match.

face_match_margin.label: Face match margin
face_match_margin.help: How much better the best match must be than the second best.

impossible_travel_kmh.label: Impossible travel speed
impossible_travel_kmh.help: A punch that would need a faster trip from the same person's punch at another attendance device is flagged for review.

salary_day_basis.label: Salary day basis
salary_day_basis.help: Days used to work out the per-day salary (26, 30 or actual days).

min_minutes_before_out.label: Earliest OUT after IN
min_minutes_before_out.help: A scan this soon after an IN is refused as “Already IN”, so a double scan never closes the day by mistake.

open_in_max_hours.label: Longest open IN
open_in_max_hours.help: If the last IN is older than this, the next scan is a new IN and the old day stays incomplete. 20 hours covers a 12-hour night shift.

snapshot_dark_threshold.label: Dark photo limit
snapshot_dark_threshold.help: A photo whose average brightness is below this gets the Dark photo mark in the punch log. The punch itself is decided as normal.

qr_card_default_validity_months.label: Default card validity
qr_card_default_validity_months.help: The end date suggested when a card is issued. The Super Admin can still pick another date.

qr_card_expiring_soon_days.label: “Ends soon” warning
qr_card_expiring_soon_days.help: Cards that end within this many days show “Ends soon” and are counted on the dashboard.

kiosk_voice_enabled.label: Voice
kiosk_voice_enabled.help: The attendance device says “Checked in”, “Checked out” or the reason, in English. The name is never spoken.

kiosk_sound_enabled.label: Sounds
kiosk_sound_enabled.help: Short tones: two rising notes when accepted, one soft note for already punched, two low notes when rejected.

kiosk_result_seconds.label: Result screen time
kiosk_result_seconds.help: How long an accepted result stays on the attendance device screen before it is ready for the next person.

kiosk_reject_seconds.label: Rejected screen time
kiosk_reject_seconds.help: Rejections stay longer, so the worker can read what to do next.

kiosk_photo_ready_seconds.label: Time to get ready for the photo
kiosk_photo_ready_seconds.help: After a card is read, the worker gets this long to look at the camera (and switch the camera) before the photo is taken. Tapping "I'm ready" takes it sooner.

face_code_offer_floor.label: Ask-for-code floor
face_code_offer_floor.help: Below this score the face is simply not recognised. Between this score and the match threshold the gate asks for the employee code.

face_code_match_threshold.label: Face threshold after a code
face_code_match_threshold.help: When an employee types a code, the face must be at least this alike to the person with that code.

face_duplicate_threshold.label: Duplicate face threshold
face_duplicate_threshold.help: At enrolment, a new face this alike to an enrolled face is held back as a possible duplicate.

face_consistency_threshold.label: Same-person check
face_consistency_threshold.help: The pictures of one face punch must show faces at least this alike.

face_antispoof_threshold.label: Live-face check
face_antispoof_threshold.help: How sure the system must be that the face is real and not a photo or a screen. Higher is stricter.

face_min_yaw_degrees.label: Head turn needed
face_min_yaw_degrees.help: How far the head must turn at the gate, in degrees.

face_frontal_max_yaw_degrees.label: Straight face limit
face_frontal_max_yaw_degrees.help: The first and the last picture must be at least this straight, in degrees.

face_challenge_steps.label: Head turns at the gate
face_challenge_steps.help: 1 = one turn. 2 = two turns in a row (for example left, then right): harder to fake, a little slower.

face_min_face_px.label: Smallest face
face_min_face_px.help: A smaller face (in pixels, counted at 640 pixels picture width) asks the person to come closer.

face_blur_min.label: Sharpness needed
face_blur_min.help: Blurry pictures are refused. A higher number is stricter.

face_brightness_min.label: Brightness needed
face_brightness_min.help: Darker pictures are refused (0 is black, 255 is white).

face_challenge_seconds.label: Time for the head turn
face_challenge_seconds.help: How long the person has to turn the head after the device asks.

face_code_entry_seconds.label: Time to type the code
face_code_entry_seconds.help: How long the employee code pad stays open.

face_code_max_tries.label: Code tries
face_code_max_tries.help: How many times a wrong employee code can be typed before the punch is refused.

face_reenrol_code_count.label: Re-enrol hint: codes typed
face_reenrol_code_count.help: Suggest enrolling a face again when this many code entries happen within 30 days.

face_reenrol_score_margin.label: Re-enrol hint: falling score
face_reenrol_score_margin.help: Suggest enrolling a face again when recent match scores fall this far below the older ones.

company_address.label: Company address
company_address.help: The registered address of Sheet Shapers. The consent text and the privacy notice name it.

privacy_contact.label: Privacy contact (grievance officer)
privacy_contact.help: Who employees contact about their data: name, role and how to reach them (phone or email).

impossible_travel_min_distance_m.label: Impossible travel: shortest distance

privacy.title: Face and photo attendance at Sheet Shapers
privacy.lead: How the gate attendance devices use your face and photos, why, for how long, and what you can do. In plain words.

purpose.title: Only for attendance
purpose.text: Never shared, never sent to an AI company.

template.title: Numbers, not pictures
template.text: We keep an encrypted face template, not your photos.

choice.title: Your choice
choice.text: Say no and punch with a QR card. Nothing else changes.

questions.title: Questions?
questions.text: Ask the plant office, or the contact below.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.faceLead: If you punch with your face:
collect.template: A face template. At enrolment the camera takes 5 pictures of your face. The system turns them into a list of numbers that describes your face. The pictures are deleted at once. Only the template is kept, and it is encrypted.
collect.pictures: Pictures at each face punch. The device takes a few pictures. The server compares them with your template and then deletes them.
collect.photo: One small photo when a face punch fails or you type your employee code, so the plant office can check what happened.
collect.cardLead: If you punch with a QR card: one photo at each card punch, checked automatically to see that a face is present.
collect.everyone: For everyone: your name, employee code, plant, and the time and device of each punch.

why.title: Why
why.text: Only to record your attendance and to stop anyone else from marking attendance for you.
why.more: Your face data is not used for anything else, is not shared, and is never sent to any AI company. Card photos are checked automatically only to see that a face is present.

keep.title: How long we keep it
keep.templateWhen: Until you leave or withdraw your consent
keep.pictures: Pictures taken at a face punch
keep.failedPhoto: Photo of a failed punch, or when you type your code
keep.after: When you leave the company or withdraw your consent, your template is deleted at once.

where.title: Where it is processed
where.text: The pictures are checked in memory on our hosting provider's server in Singapore. The encrypted template and the photos are stored in Mumbai. The storage provider does not have the key to open them.

see.title: Who can see it
see.text: No person can see your template. Only the Super Admin can see the small photos of failed punches, and every view is recorded. The Plant Head and the Corporate Head see only whether, when and how you punched.

choice.title: Your choice, and how to withdraw
choice.text: You do not have to agree to face attendance. If you do not agree, you get a QR ID card to punch with instead. Saying no, or withdrawing later, will not affect your job, pay, shift or treatment in any way.
choice.withdraw: To withdraw, tell the plant office. That is enough. Your template is then deleted and you get a QR card.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can ask what data we keep about you, ask to correct or delete it, and raise a complaint. Your attendance records (punch times) are kept as labour law requires, even after your face data is deleted.
